# Yards Per Play

> **Two source classes on this page, never mixed in one claim.** *How the guide defines it*, *how the guide uses it* and every page reference are **GUIDE CONTENT**. *Working definition*, *why it matters* and any arithmetic over printed figures are **TTW DERIVED** — this library's words, supplied because the guide supplies none. ## How the guide defines it

p. 2: `YPP – Yards per Play`. The gloss expands the abbreviation and stops there.

## How the guide uses it

A printed category on both sides of every team's statistics table, with a value and a national rank, for all 138 teams. It is one of the six terms the guide's analytical vocabulary is actually built on.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

Total yards divided by total offensive plays — a per-snap efficiency rate that strips out how many plays a team ran.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

It separates efficiency from volume. A team can gain a lot of yards by running a lot of plays; yards per play asks how much each snap was worth, which is why it survives tempo differences that raw yardage does not.

## How bettors use it in this guide

As a printed reference figure with a rank rather than as an argued metric. The guide rarely reasons aloud from yards per play in prose; it prints it and lets the rank speak.

p. 2 for the abbreviation; every team's right-hand page for the value and rank on both sides of the ball.
